articles.title: Bitcoin options remain expensive despite summer calm. Here's why it matters
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s implied volatility is near a seasonal floor, but options continue to price substantially more movement than the market is delivering.

articles.title: Bitpanda fined 70,000 euros in Austria’s first published MiCA enforcement case
articles.snippet: The fine stems from Bitpanda failing to submit a mandatory white paper 20 days before publication and omitting required disclosures in marketing materials.

articles.title: September Fed interest-rate increase is 'very unlikely,' Goldman Sachs says
articles.snippet: Soft economic data has Goldman Sachs doubting a September rate increase, offering good news for bitcoin bulls.

articles.title: The bitcoin futures market looks like a crowded club with a tiny exit – and it could cause pain
articles.snippet: The market may be facing a dangerous liquidity mismatch as futures open interest outpaces trading volume by a significant margin.

articles.title: CFTC seeks public input on AI compute futures contracts as CME eyes October launch
articles.snippet: The regulatory review could shape an emerging market that lets companies and investors trade and hedge the cost of increasingly scarce AI computing power.
